## Setting up the hardware

- **AMI light traps and LepiSense:** the [AMI system deployment guide](https://github.com/AMI-system/ami-system-deployment-guide).
- **Sound recorders and bat detectors:** follow the maker's instructions, and see [Getting started](getting-started.qmd#before-you-go-out) for what to note down.

## Analysing data yourself

Our [open-source toolkit](https://github.com/NERC-CEH/ceh-biomonitoring) runs the same AI models we use, on your own computer, in Python or R. It has its own guides: finding birds, bats and moths, having results checked by experts, reports, and making videos and soundscapes.

**Stuck?** Email [alyduf@ceh.ac.uk](mailto:alyduf@ceh.ac.uk).
